subject.title: Feature: add gateway.controlUi.timezone for Control UI timestamp rendering

question: Should OpenClaw add a public `gateway.controlUi.timezone` setting for Control UI timestamp rendering, and which values/default should that contract support?
rationale: The request adds a new public Gateway Control UI config/bootstrap surface, and repository policy treats config/default additions as compatibility-sensitive product decisions rather than automatic bug fixes.

options.title: Approve Narrow Additive Config
options.body: Accept an additive timezone setting after the linked PR resolves values, default browser behavior, docs, validation, and proof without breaking existing `timeFormat` rendering.

options.title: Use Existing Timezone Concepts Only
options.body: Reject the new Control UI key and keep `agents.defaults.userTimezone` and envelope timezone concepts scoped to prompt/envelope behavior unless another UI design is chosen.

options.title: Defer For Broader UI Time Settings
options.body: Keep the issue as a product-design thread for a broader date/time display model instead of landing a one-off Control UI field now.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Additive Config
recommendation.body: Accept an additive timezone setting after the linked PR resolves values, default browser behavior, docs, validation, and proof without breaking existing `timeFormat` rendering.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the bootstrap contract boundary and is the strongest available feature-history signal for deciding whether a new Control UI bootstrap/config surface belongs there.
